reviews.text: I highly recommend this if your dealing with a broken barrier! I had a reaction from some products that had oils in them. In result I got contact dermatitis. I was all red, itchy, and burning! I used aestura 365 lotion which helped. Let me tell you tho! Once I tried the centella soothing cream my skin felt so graceful! This cream that looks like a gel instantly cools your skin. The feeling is just so amazing it's a lot like aloe vera. I just wish it was a bigger container. A little goes a long ways tho. Even a pea size amount will distribute a lot more than you would expect! It doesn't asborb quickly but I think it's actually beneficial for comforting disturbed skin.
reviews.zh: 如果你嘅皮膚屏障受損，真係好推薦呢款！我之前用咗一啲含油成分嘅產品，皮膚有反應，結果變咗接觸性皮膚炎，成塊面又紅又痕又熱辣辣！我用咗 aestura 365 乳液有幫助。但要同你講！一用咗呢款 centella 舒緩面霜，皮膚即刻覺得好舒服！望落似 gel 嘅面霜，一搽上去即刻有涼感。嗰種感覺真係好正，好似蘆薈咁。我只係恨佢細咗少少。其實少量已經好夠用，連豌豆咁細嘅分量都可以推得比想像中更廣！佢唔會好快吸收，但我反而覺得呢樣對舒敏有幫助。

reviews.text: This is my favorite soothing cream, I've been using it for over a month and I refuse to buy any other. It calms down and brightens my combination acne prone skin, and each time I use it I notice a difference within hours. Photos reflect pre, 4 days post and 1 month progression of my skin. This is probably my top favorite of all Skin1004 products and really holds up as a base when using a light amount of foundation onto of it for a natural dewy finish 5*
reviews.zh: 呢款係我最鍾意嘅舒緩面霜，用咗超過一個月，唔想再換其他。佢可以舒敏同提亮我呢種容易爆瘡嘅混合性肌，每次用完幾個鐘內都見到分別。相入面係用前、用咗 4 日同用咗 1 個月嘅皮膚變化。呢款應該係我用過所有 Skin1004 產品入面最鍾意嘅一款，而且薄薄搽一層粉底上面做底妝，個妝可以好自然咁有水光感 5*

reviews.text:
I love this! I was a bit hesitant using it because I wear glasses and oily products make my glasses slip down more easily. However, this smoothing cream is not oily at all. It does take a while to absorb because it it a cream, but after drying it leaves my skin nourished. It doesn’t even feel like I put it on. 
One small complaint I would make is that some of the product is left on the mouth/hole because of its concave nature. It would be better if it was built flat like other product designs. The photo provided shows that there is still some leftover product on the mouth piece even though I swiped it off and applied on my skin. 
The clear design is very pretty though!
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意！本來有啲猶豫，因為我戴眼鏡，搽咗油性產品眼鏡就會成日滑落嚟。但呢款 smoothing cream 完全唔油。因為係 cream 狀，所以要一啲時間先吸收，但乾咗之後皮膚會覺得滋潤，甚至感覺唔到自己搽咗嘢。
唯一一個小投訴係，因為個開口位係凹落去，所以有啲產品會黐喺嗰度。如果可以好似其他產品咁做平嘅開口會更好。雖然我已經刮走再搽上面，相入面都仲見到開口位有返啲產品黐住。
不過個透明設計真係好靚！

reviews.text: I've been using this for a week now and notice it does help quite a bit. It's very cooling and helps calm the redness of my skin. It has a gel-like consistency so it spreads nicely and is lightweight. A little does go a long way, so if you use too much at once the skin does get a bit sticky. Otherwise thin layer absorbs pretty well. Good for sensitive and irritated skin types.
reviews.zh: 用咗一個星期，明顯覺得有幫助。佢好涼爽，可以舒緩到我皮膚嘅泛紅。質地似 gel，所以容易推開，感覺輕盈。少量已經好夠用，所以一次搽太多嘅話皮膚會有少少黏笠。不過薄搽嘅話，吸收得幾好。敏感肌同受刺激嘅膚質都好啱用。

reviews.text:
I love how soothing it is.
 It absorbs ultra quickly and is immediately soothing. 

I got this as a non sticky moisturiser to lock in my layers of serums. Love that it does that perfectly and leaves a smooth finish. And also discovered that it’s a perfect soothing agent if my skin needs some comfort after a heavy dose of retinol or of the sun.
reviews.zh:
我鍾意佢嘅舒緩效果。
佢吸收得超快，即時有舒緩感覺。

我當佢係一款唔黏笠嘅保濕霜用嚟鎖住之前嗰幾層精華。佢做到呢樣嘢之餘仲唔黏笠，個妝感好滑。另外發現如果皮膚用完高濃度 retinol 或者曬完太陽之後想舒緩一下，佢真係一流。

reviews.text:
I have been using the entire Madagascar Centella line for over a month now and I can confidently say that it has changed my skin for the better. My skin’s texture is smoother, brighter and I no longer get those painful cystic acne, sometimes 1 hormonal pimple a month during my period which is manageable.

1. I double cleanse using the oil cleanser and then the ampoule foam cleanser
2. Toner
3. Ampoule 
4. Soothing cream
5. Cream
6. Sun cream (during the day)

Same routine for night time except sun cream.
reviews.zh:
我用咗成個 Madagascar Centella 系列超過一個月，我可以好肯定咁講，佢真係令我嘅皮膚變好咗。皮膚質地更滑更亮，嗰啲痛到入肉嘅囊腫暗瘡已經冇再出，有時經期嗰陣一個月可能會出 1 粒生理暗瘡，都仲算控制到。

1. 用卸妝油再用 ampoule 泡沫潔面雙重清潔
2. 爽膚水
3. 安瓶
4. 舒緩面霜
5. 面霜
6. 防曬（日頭先用）

夜晚都係用同一個程序，只係唔用防曬。

reviews.text: This soothing cream is so incredible. This is the first time I have used this face cream. I feel so happy that I decided to buy this. During using this cream, I feel my face so soft both after use and when I wake up. Besides, I didn't feel any allergic or itching feelings because my skin is sensitive kind.
reviews.zh: 呢款舒緩面霜真係超正。第一次用呢款面霜，慶幸自己決定買咗佢。用緊期間，無論用完即時定係第二朝起身，塊面都覺得好軟。雖然我係敏感肌，但用完完全冇敏感或者痕癢嘅感覺。

reviews.text:
Really moisturising gel that doesn't feel heavy or make my skin have that cold sweaty feeling. 
I was scared it would run out quickly in a squeeze bottle but you only need a tiny amount each time (less than a lea for the whole face and neck) so I'm really happy with this purchase.
It might be too light for winter but for people with oilier skin, this is amazing for humid springs
reviews.zh:
真係好保濕嘅 gel，唔厚重，亦唔會令皮膚有嗰種冷冰冰、出晒汗嘅感覺。
本來仲驚支軟枝裝好快用完，但其實每次用量好少（搽全面同頸只需要好少嘅份量），所以我對呢次買得好滿意。
冬天用可能會嫌太輕，但油性肌嘅人喺潮濕嘅春天用呢款會好正。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
